Below the head, a small tattered ghost hem that tapers to a floating point - no legs and no feet at all. Two short stubby arms ending in chunky little claw hands, held out to the sides.

SILHOUETTE: about as WIDE as it is TALL, filling a roughly square area. The big head and the outstretched stubby arms give it the width. It must read as a clear, simple, rounded shape at 51 pixels tall on screen.

TECHNICAL OUTPUT: square, TRANSPARENT background (real alpha channel), single isolated creature, centred, small even margin on all sides.

EXCLUDE: realistic proportions, a tall thin shape, a narrow column, long limbs, cast shadows on the ground, ground plane, scenery, props, other characters, text, labels, UI, frames, watermark, signature, cropped limbs, motion blur.
